share_docs.message: Cannot share company documents without explicit intern confirmation. Send welcome email first and wait for confirmation.

share_international_docs.message: International documents require both intern confirmation and international status on file.

schedule_intro_meeting.message: Cannot schedule meetings before intern confirms their start date.

create_account.message: Account creation requires confirmation and shared documentation. Complete those steps first.

grant_system_access.message: Cannot grant system access when access is delayed. Use request_alternative_access instead.

request_alternative_access.message: Alternative access path only applies to interns with a confirmed access delay.

send_followup_email.message: Follow-up email requires at least 1 day without intern response. It is too early to send a follow-up.

escalate_to_manager.message: Escalation requires 3+ days without response and no confirmation yet. Try a follow-up email first if fewer than 3 days have passed.
